newsitem.title: USA: FERC backs Pony Express switch to natgas pipeline.
newsitem.headline: FERC backs Pony Express switch to natgas pipeline.

text.p: The U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission Wednesday approved K N Interstate Gas Transmission Co's plan to convert the Pony Express oil pipeline into a natural gas pipeline.
K N Interstate is a subsidiary of K N Energy Inc.
The pipeline would operate in Wyoming, Colorado, Nebraska, Kansas and Missouri, carrying natural gas produced in the Rocky Mountain area to Mid-Continent markets.
"The Pony Express project brings significant reserves to market in an area where there is inadequate capacity," said Commissioner James Hoecker.

Commissioners praised the project, saying the company would save about $60 million by converting the oil pipeline instead of building a new pipeline, which in turn would allow it to lower rates to all its customers.
